title: PongLens
tagline: A coaching hub built around every student.

delivery.instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a coach explaining something useful to another coach. Unhurried and even. Nothing is sold and nothing is hurried. No rising lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: PongLens is a coaching workspace built around every student you work with.

lines.label: Your students
lines.text: Each student has one place for their lesson history, shared notes, recordings and matches, so the full picture stays together.

lines.label: Coaching journals
lines.text: Keep a coaching journal that shows what you worked on, what changed and what comes next.

lines.label: Lesson recording
lines.text: Record the lesson as audio, with video recording coming soon. PongLens prepares the transcript and a structured entry for you to review.

lines.label: Shared with students
lines.text: Share the parts your student needs, so your coaching stays with them when the session ends.

lines.label: Match feedback
lines.text: When they share a match, it sits beside the lessons and notes that led to it.

lines.label: Match feedback
lines.text: Watch it point by point, and tie your feedback to the exact rallies that show what you mean.

lines.label: Paid reviews
lines.text: If you coach remotely, you can also offer paid match reviews with your own scope, price and turnaround.
PongLens. Coaching that carries from one session to the next.
